_comment: The App Store screenshots, one entry each: what it shows and the stage.sh variables that stage it (SCOPE/GALLERY/TAB/CAMERA/CALENDAR/PHOTO/PINS/SELECT/SHEET). `stage_<lang>` overrides per language (the pins' notes); `{instance}` is the instance below, or INSTANCE= from the environment. `store` is the carousel order; shoot.sh walks `capture` order and stages each shot by relaunching the app, so nothing is set up by hand. A `by_hand` note pauses the capture for something that still is. The values here stage the built-in demo; for the real set, point `instance` at the account the shots come from and swap the galleries, dates, photo ids and camera to its photos. See SCREENSHOTS.md.

map.title: Every photo on the map
map.about: The hero: a city's worth of photo pins and piles, one opened to its thumbnails. Where the diary has been, at a glance.
